verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a monthly spend cap per API key or service account, and service accounts let spend be tracked separately from any human user. That covers the per-key dimension of the story. The evidence does not show budgets scoped to teams or individual users, and it does not say whether caps hard-block requests or how they are enforced. Missing for 10: per-team budgets, per-user budgets, explicit hard-stop enforcement behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
